summary.en: The Philippine Navy, Coast Guard and United States Navy conducted a joint maritime cooperative activity in the West Philippine Sea, while the Philippines launched a five-day maritime defence drill along eastern Mindanao seaboard and opened an upgraded Coast Guard station on Pag-asa Island. China warned the Philippines to stop provocations and also warned Taiwan that it must bear consequences for using water cannons against a Chinese ship, echoing similar warnings to Taiwan. Japan is providing support for Philippine Coast Guard modernization, and the United States secured a foreign military sales contract for Coast Guard boats up to $12.2 million. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
